name: 25B-NBOH
toxicities: Potentially fatal at heavy dosages; the source says an LD50 has not been determined.
effectsSummary: Anecdotal effect reports describe prominent visual effects and stimulation. Possible adverse effects listed include increased heart rate and blood pressure, abnormal heartbeat, impaired temperature regulation, and seizures; effects are not predictable or reliable.
dosageRemark: No dose thresholds are established, and the dose-response is described as sensitive and unpredictable. High doses are warned against.
generalRisks: Of potential serious injury or death. No deaths had been reported for this compound, while the suggested similarity to 25B-NBOMe is an inference rather than direct evidence. Human pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity data are extremely limited.
saferUse: Insufflation and high doses are strongly discouraged, with warnings of possible serious injury or death and of an unpredictable dose-response.
metabolism: How the body breaks it down has not yet been verified for this entry. No enzymes, breakdown products or elimination routes are specified.
summary: 25B-NBOH is a synthetic phenethylamine in the NBOH family, chemically related to 25B-NBOMe. Human pharmacology and toxicity data are limited.
longtermRisks: Long-term health effects are not established. The toxicity and harm-potential section is explicitly marked as a stub that may contain dangerous errors, so it cannot support long-term conclusions.
